paper.title_en: Coupling of two individual magnon resonators via a superconducting microwave resonator operating in the strong coupling regime
paper.abstract_en: We demonstrate coherent coupling of ferromagnetic resonance in two individual permalloy stripes via a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator. The two stripes are placed on top of the resonator with an angle of 50$^{\circ}$ between their respective long axes. This alignment enables us to separately tune their ferromagnetic resonance frequency by exploiting their shape anisotropy by simply rotating the external bias magnetic field in the sample plane. Both individual ferromagnets exhibit strong coupling with the microwave resonator. This method avoids the use of local individual bias coils and facilitates the integration of similar experiments into planar device infrastructures.
